description: This file defines a PaymentsService class that provides stub methods for creating and confirming payment intents, supporting multiple payment methods such as card, wallet, and cash-on-delivery. It includes placeholder logic for integrating with external payment gateways like Stripe and Razorpay.

classes.name: PaymentsService
classes.description: Provides methods to create and confirm payment intents with stubbed logic, supporting various payment methods and gateway integrations.

methods.name: createIntent({ amountLKR, currency = 'LKR', method = 'cod', metadata = {} })
methods.description: Creates a payment intent or session based on the provided payment method and amount, returning a stubbed response or a mock online payment intent.

methods.name: confirm({ paymentId })
methods.description: Confirms a payment using the provided payment ID, returning a success status.

ctags.name: createIntent
ctags.pattern: /^  async createIntent({ amountLKR, currency = 'LKR', method = 'cod', metadata = {} }) {$/
